from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json
from PIL import Image,ImageDraw,ImageFont
ROOT=Path('/Users/sunjaekim/Developer/oil_level_tracker')
D=ROOT/'docs/50-diagnostics/s11'
OUT=ROOT/'sample/output/s11-upper-projection-ac-review-20261010-001'
OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
inventory_path=D/'2026-10-10-water-first-source-qualification.json'
inventory=json.loads(inventory_path.read_text())
source_cases={c['frame_index']:c for c in inventory['preflight']['cases']}
cases=[]
for label,frame,role,rows,reply in [
 ('A',1232,'Foam upper outline',[476,481],'2026-10-10-water-foam-role-reply.json'),
 ('C',1643,'Water upper surface',[489,494],'2026-10-10-later-water-role-reply.json')]:
 c=source_cases[frame]
 cases.append({'label':label,'case_id':c['case_id'],'frame_index':frame,'nominal_time_sec':c['nominal_time_sec'],
               'source_raster':c['source_raster'],'physical_role':role,
               'role_reply':{'path':str((D/reply).relative_to(ROOT)),'sha256':sha(D/reply)},
               'source_x':950,'proposed_pixel_rows_inclusive':rows,'proposed_y_cell_bounds':[rows[0]-.5,rows[1]+.5],
               'authority':'agent native-source visual proposal, not reviewed position truth',
               'status':'PENDING_HUMAN_INTERVAL_REVIEW'})
inputs={str(p.relative_to(ROOT)):sha(p) for p in [inventory_path,D/'2026-10-10-upper-projection-choice.json',D/'2026-10-10-upper-projection-interval-reply.json',D/'2026-10-10-water-lower-interface-reply.json',*[ROOT/c['source_raster']['path'] for c in cases],*[ROOT/c['role_reply']['path'] for c in cases]]}
for c in cases:assert sha(ROOT/c['source_raster']['path'])==c['source_raster']['sha256']
preflight={'schema':'s11-upper-projection-ac-source-preparation-v1','base_head':'f9737d3caa290b6aee80da2f9e4320b6b1f0f535',
 'inputs':inputs,'cases':cases,'source_video':'sample/sample5.mp4','source_video_sha256':'8c5d2708d602bfb5b1d6f8ff12757255a86d607caf6914b153ea6e39c4457e79',
 'source_region_xyxy':[740,250,1160,1080],'display_context_xyxy':[740,310,1160,760],'detail_xyxy':[840,450,1070,510],
 'choice':'fixed-center-upper-image-projection-v1','geometry':'diagnostic X950 only, no calibrated Glass/zero line/mm',
 'basis':'Direct clean source inspection at the same pre-existing column, independently for each frame. No new detector outcome, residual or tolerance optimization used. Prior diagnostics already exposed these development sources.',
 'purpose':'Qualify Foam-upper A independently of its already-unclear lower interface, and water-upper C independently of B. A second water point in the same recording is not recording-level independence or holdout.',
 'stop_rule':'Do not score or execute a revised selector against these proposed intervals before the human answer. A rejected/unclear interval remains unresolved and is not an absence label. No propagation to other frames.',
 'runner_sha256':sha(Path(__file__)),'production_changed':False,'legacy_truth_changed':False,'windows_required':False}
(OUT/'preflight.json').write_text(json.dumps(preflight,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
(OUT/'run.py').write_bytes(Path(__file__).read_bytes())
fontpath='/System/Library/Fonts/Supplemental/Arial.ttf'
font=lambda size:ImageFont.truetype(fontpath,size)
im=Image.new('RGB',(1440,1240),'#f5f7fb');draw=ImageDraw.Draw(im)
draw.text((24,16),'A and C: upper projection at the same diagnostic source column',font=font(26),fill='#15283b')
draw.text((24,49),'Source-position review only. Yellow boxes are proposed uncertainty, not thickness or detector output.',font=font(18),fill='#40566b')
clean_checks=[]
for c,base in zip(cases,(110,700)):
 source=Image.open(ROOT/c['source_raster']['path']).convert('RGB')
 context=source.crop(tuple(preflight['display_context_xyxy']))
 detail=source.crop(tuple(preflight['detail_xyxy'])).resize((920,240),Image.Resampling.NEAREST)
 draw.text((24,base-30),f"{c['label']} / {c['physical_role']} / {c['nominal_time_sec']:.3f} s",font=font(21),fill='#15283b')
 im.paste(context,(24,base));im.paste(detail,(480,base))
 annotated_y=base+276
 im.paste(detail,(480,annotated_y))
 draw.text((480,annotated_y-26),'Same pixels, with X950 and proposed range',font=font(18),fill='#40566b')
 cx=480+(950-840+.5)*4
 for y in range(annotated_y,annotated_y+240,10):draw.line((cx,y,cx,min(y+5,annotated_y+239)),fill='#00efd8',width=2)
 lo,hi=c['proposed_pixel_rows_inclusive'];top=annotated_y+(lo-450)*4;bottom=annotated_y+(hi+1-450)*4-1
 draw.rectangle((cx-10,top,cx+10,bottom),outline='#ffe74c',width=3)
 draw.line((cx+12,(top+bottom)/2,1050,annotated_y+35),fill='#ffe74c',width=2)
 draw.text((1058,annotated_y+15),f"{c['label']}: source rows {lo} - {hi}",font=font(19),fill='#ffe74c')
 draw.text((24,base+465),'Native source context; right detail is 4x nearest.',font=font(16),fill='#40566b')
 clean_checks.append({'case_id':c['case_id'],'context_equal':im.crop((24,base,444,base+450)).tobytes()==context.tobytes(),
                      'detail_equal':im.crop((480,base,1400,base+240)).tobytes()==detail.tobytes()})
assert all(c['context_equal'] and c['detail_equal'] for c in clean_checks)
image_path=D/'2026-10-10-upper-projection-ac-review.png';im.save(image_path)
for name,pin in inputs.items():assert sha(ROOT/name)==pin,name
record={'schema':'s11-upper-projection-ac-review-v1','preflight':preflight,'preflight_sha256':sha(OUT/'preflight.json'),
 'image':{'path':str(image_path.relative_to(ROOT)),'sha256':sha(image_path),'size':list(im.size)},
 'clean_panels_verified':clean_checks,'inputs_preserved':True,
 'review_question':'A에서는 거품층 윗면, C에서는 수면의 위쪽 윤곽이 청록색 중앙선과 만나는 위치를 표시했습니다. 작은 노란 상자가 각 위치의 가능한 범위를 담고 있다고 봐도 될까요? A의 불명확한 아래 경계는 이번 확인 대상이 아닙니다.',
 'status':'PENDING_HUMAN_INTERVAL_REVIEW','script':(OUT/'run.py').read_text(),
 'local_artifacts':{str(p.relative_to(ROOT)):sha(p) for p in (OUT/'preflight.json',OUT/'run.py')},
 'detector_executed':False,'production_changed':False,'new_numeric_truth':False}
(D/'2026-10-10-upper-projection-ac-review.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
print('AC_SOURCE_PREPARATION_VERIFIED',image_path)
